# ESE Seal

ESE Seal is a Springfield, Missouri masonry restoration, concrete repair and waterproofing company owned by Eric Enlow.

## Primary services
- Masonry repair for brick, stone and block
- Brick and stone tuckpointing
- Chimney and fireplace masonry repair
- Concrete foundation and poured wall crack repair
- Basement and foundation waterproofing / weatherproofing
- Concrete flatwork repair and resurfacing
- Exterior caulking and sealing

## Service area
ESE Seal is based in Springfield, Missouri and serves Springfield and surrounding Southwest Missouri communities, including Nixa, Ozark, Rogersville and Hollister.
